mods.name: Arcforge
mods.description: Arcforge is a technology mod built on Forge Energy (FE), compatible with any NeoForge mod that uses the standard energy, fluid and item capabilities.

releases.notes:
### Added

- **The fusion tier** (the **Arcforge: Fusion** creative tab, the Handbook's Fusion chapter and a Fusion quest chapter
  after Nuclear Power). A tokamak **Fusion Reactor** one tier above the Fission Reactor, run by a 0-D plasma model
  stepped once a second (IPB98(y,2) confinement, D-T and D-He3 reactivities, the Greenwald, beta and q95 limits,
  vertical stability, flux-limited pulses), giving about 3.5M FE/t at the smallest size (two Nuclear Steam Turbines) and
  23.5M FE/t at the largest (ten) through Steam Generators.
  - **Fuels and gases**: Deuterium (electrolysed from Heavy Water), Tritium, Helium, Helium-3, Argon and Fusion
    Exhaust. Some natural gas caps are **helium-rich** (`world.oilDeposits.heliumRichChance`): their wellheads give Helium-Rich
    Natural Gas.
  - **Lithium-6**: the **Lithium Isotope Separator** enriches Lithium Fluoride a step a pass (Enriched Lithium
    Fluoride, then **Lithium-6 Fluoride**). It makes **Lithium Target Rods** for the Fission Reactor, which breed
    tritium (a mild poison). The **Tritium Extraction Unit** bakes them out with heat. Lead and Lithium-6 Fluoride make
    **Lead-Lithium**, the blanket's coolant and breeder.
  - **Cryogenics**: the **Cryogenic Plant** (a 3–7 cold box) liquefies Nitrogen and Helium. The **Cryogenic
    Distillation Column** (3×3, 6–16 tall, a refinery-style tower with platforms) distils air into Nitrogen, Oxygen and Argon, and Helium-Rich Natural
    Gas into Natural Gas and Helium. Liquid Nitrogen and Liquid Helium boil off out of every tank except the new
    **Cryogenic Tank**.
  - **Superconducting magnets**: Arcite-Tungsten Wire (pressed), Superconducting Tape (sintered) and Superconducting
    Coils. These make the Toroidal Field, Poloidal Field and Central Solenoid coils and the Stellarator Coil.
  - **The tokamak**: a compact ring of major radius 3 to 7, laid out in layers round its axis: the Central Solenoid, the
    First Wall and Divertor round the plasma chamber, the Breeding Blanket as its outer wall, the field coils closing it
    top and bottom, and a Cryostat wall of Cryostat Casing with Vessel Ports and Reactor Glass viewports. The footprint
    runs from 9×9×9 to 17×17×13. Its model shows the plated cryostat, and the plasma glows
    through the windows while it burns. Built with Stellarator Coils, it is a **Stellarator** instead: steady, with
    no current and no disruptions, but weaker confinement.
  - **Port modules** on Vessel Ports: the Neutral Beam Injector, Gyrotron, Pellet Injector, Gas Puff Valve, Cryopump,
    Diagnostics Port and **Direct Energy Converter** (it catches the plasma's charged-particle outflow, up to 250 MW, and
    makes FE of it at half again the thermal route's rate; D-He3 sends almost all its power that way).
  - **Running it**: a control desk with three pages (Plasma, Plant, Control), a start-up checklist, setpoints,
    D-T or D-He3, Repeat, redstone, the machine control API, and **Fast Shutdown**. Alarms cover density, beta,
    vertical drift, pulse end, vacuum, coolant, magnets, wear, disruptions, quenches and tritium release.
  - **Failures and maintenance**:
    - **Disruptions** wear the wall, and runaway electrons can burn through and leak the vacuum.
    - **Quenches** damage coils unless **Quench Protection Units** take the energy.
    - Loss of coolant overheats the reactor, and tritium can be released.
    - Parts wear and become neutron-activated. The **Remote Handling Arm** swaps worn parts through a Vessel Port while
      the reactor is shut down and gives back **Activated Components**, which the Geological Repository stores.
  - **The Tritium Plant** (3–7 across, 3–5 tall) separates Fusion Exhaust into Deuterium, Tritium, Helium-3 and
    Helium. Tritium decays to Helium-3 wherever it's stored. It permeates out of ordinary tanks, Pressurized
    Cylinders, canisters and cartridges as contamination; the double-walled **Tritium Canister** keeps it.

releases.notes:
### Added

- **Arcforged tools and armour.** A tier above netherite on the steel tools' and armour's shapes: Arcforged Sword,
  Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe, Hammer and Excavator (3×3, like the steel ones), Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings and Boots.
  Tools last 3,072 uses at speed 11, mine what netherite mines and hit harder (a 9-damage sword); armour gives
  4 / 9 / 7 / 4 armour, 4 toughness and 0.15 knockback resistance a piece. All repair with Arcforged Alloy, are fire
  resistant like netherite, survive explosions as items, and take every enchantment and armour trim. Upgrade netherite
  gear at the Smithing Table with the new **Arcforged Upgrade Template** (Arcite-Tungsten Composite, Iolite Crystals and a
  Netherite Ingot; copied with Iolite Crystals and a Block of Steel) and an Arcforged Alloy, keeping enchantments, trim,
  name and the share of wear; the Hammer and Excavator upgrade from steel with two Arcforged Alloy. Each piece holds
  512,000 FE, charged like the other FE gear: while charged, wear costs 100 FE a point instead of durability and it
  slowly repairs itself; empty, it wears like any gear. A cyan charge bar sits over the durability bar, and the Arcite
  inlay (and worn armour's visor, chest and shoulder seams) glows while charged. Values are in the `arcforgedGear`
  config section. Includes Handbook entry, JEI info, Tools & Gear quests and GameTests.
- **Gas output vent controls.** Buttons directly beneath the gas gauges provide individual overflow toggles for refinery units, the Steam Cracker,
  chemical reactors and arrays, the Gasifier, Haber Reactor, Distillation Array, Biogas Digester, Air Separator and
  Fermenter. Vents discard excess gas while keeping the stored buffer; liquid outputs still require room. Settings
  persist with the machine and copy through Settings Cards. Air Separator and Fermenter vents start enabled.
- **Chunk Loading Upgrade for the Quantum Tunnel.** Right-click a Quantum Tunnel with it to fit it (one per tunnel);
  the tunnel then keeps its own chunk loaded for its owner, like a Chunk Loader at radius 0, across restarts. It counts
  toward `chunksPerPlayer` and follows the other `logistics.chunkLoader` settings; when `energyPerChunk` is above 0 it
  pays from the frequency's FE buffer. Sneak-right-click the tunnel with an empty hand to take it out; breaking the
  tunnel drops it. Jade shows its status. Crafted from a Chunk Loader, two Ender Pearls, two Arcite and four Steel
  Plates.
- **Industrial Water Intake Seawater mode.** A button in its GUI (left of the river/ocean line, showing a swatch of
  what it pumps) switches it between Water and Seawater. On Seawater it pumps Seawater where its intake is in an ocean
  or beach biome (the Electric Pump's `seawaterBiomeTags`) at its usual rate, and Water anywhere else. Switching
  empties its tank. Intakes start on Water, so boilers fed from the sea keep running; Settings Cards copy the mode,
  and Jade says when it's pumping Seawater.
- **Separate dyed conduit items.** All sixteen colors have registered items for every conduit type and tier. Dyeing,
  washing, placement, mining, pick block and tier upgrades preserve the appropriate item. Older component-colored
  stacks remain usable; tier upgrades require matching colors.
- **Included Curios API and Jetpack slot.** Jetpacks work in a dedicated accessory slot alongside chest armor, with
  their existing modes, controls, HUD, sound and worn model. Curios is embedded in the release jar; this requires
  NeoForge 26.3.0.37-beta or newer. The development JEI dependency is updated for that NeoForge version.
- **Radiation warning particles.** Green particles surround radioactive sources and radioactive contents in machines,
  conduits, inventories and dropped items. Uses the exposure source cache, loaded chunks near players and a bounded
  particle budget; `nuclear.radiation.radiationParticles` can disable the visual warning.

### Changed

- **New textures for materials.** 86 textures are redrawn: the metal storage blocks (lead, nickel, silver, steel,
  tungsten and bismuth), every raw ore block and raw ore, the dusts (metals, ores, nuclear compounds, flour, seed meal,
  salt and wood ash), the plates and gears, and the alloys (Wrought, Tempered, Hardened and Arcforged, and the
  Arcite-Tungsten Composite).

### Added

- **A questline for Hibiscus Quests.** With [Hibiscus Quests](https://github.com/hibiscus-software/hibiscus-quests)
  installed (optional), its quest book gets 20 Arcforge chapters in six groups under an Arcforge heading, and 272
  quests, from the Wrench and the Combustion Plant to molten salt reactors, covering every item you can get in survival.
  They follow the recipes: Getting Started runs Combustion Plant, Carbonizer, Arcforge Furnace, first steel, Metal Press
  and Thermoelectric Plant, and each later chapter's first quests unlock with the alloys and parts they need (the Steam
  Boiler with Tempered Alloy, chemistry with Hardened Alloy, uranium with Sulfuric Acid). Every chapter and quest,
  challenges included, can be looked at from the start, greyed out until it unlocks, so you can see what's coming. New
  with the nuclear part three are Reactor Safety (containment, ECCS, relief valves, recombiners, core catcher,
  decontamination), Fuel Cycle (spent fuel, PUREX, MOX, thorium, U-233, vitrification and the repository) and Advanced
  Cores (lead-bismuth and molten salt). Every quest is listed in docs/QUESTLINE.md; the chapters are generated from
  tools/hibiscusquests.
- **Radiation Poisoning.** Radiation now does harm at every level: a dose of 50 mSv brings Radiation Poisoning I (half a
  heart every 30 seconds, through armour), 500 II (every 10 seconds, and Hunger), 2,000 III (every 4 seconds, Hunger and
  Weakness) and 4,000 IV (a heart every 2 seconds, with Nausea), and standing in a field of 100 mSv/h or more makes it a
  level worse at once. Its icon is a green trefoil. The old Nausea / Weakness / Wither / lethal thresholds are replaced
  (config `poisoningDose1` to `poisoningDose4`, `acuteRate`, `poisoningDamage`).
- **Contaminated chunks glow** with green motes in their air, thicker the
  more contaminated they are, with ash falling where it's heavy (`falloutParticles`). Each chunk's fallout is synced to the players
  watching it.
- **Fallout spreads**: every minute 2% of each chunk's contamination (`falloutSpreadRate`, was 0.4% downwind only) goes to
  the four chunks round it, most downwind, and Corium and Solidified Corium left outside a sealed containment seep into
  their chunk's ground (`coriumSeep`).
- **Fallout ash lies like snow**: grey ash in vanilla sand's grain, in layers of 1 to 8, piling into drifts at different
  heights (far more of it than before), walkable like snow, weathering away a layer at a time as the chunk decays.
- **Corium** uses the lava texture recoloured to a molten brown, pixel for pixel, slowly rolling as it flows.
- **The nuclear tier, part one: ores, radiation, uranium chemistry and enrichment.** Civil power only: nothing in it
  makes a weapon, and enrichment stops at 20% U-235. A new **Arcforge: Nuclear** creative tab, a Nuclear chapter in the
  Handbook (ten entries) and a Nuclear advancement branch (ten advancements).
  - **Ores.** Uraninite Ore (stone and deepslate: rare, small veins, mostly below Y 0) drops Raw Uraninite and crushes
    into Uraninite Dust. Galena Ore (common at mid depths) drops Raw Galena, which makes **Lead** like the other metals

    water 0.5, stone 0.6, other solid blocks 0.8). The dose rate at a player sums every source within 16 blocks by the

### Added

- **Crude oil.** Deep underground, the world is split into regions (8 chunks across), and about a third of them hold
  an oil deposit: a round patch of chunks between Y −48 and 8. Regions in deserts, oceans, badlands and plains (the
  biome tag `arcforge:oil_rich`) have one about twice as often, and bigger. There are four kinds: Oil Seep
  (1,000–3,000 buckets), Oil Pocket (4,000–10,000), Oil Field (12,000–30,000) and Giant Oil Field (40,000–100,000), the
  Giant the rarest. Deposits follow from the world seed alone and every well over one shares it. A drained deposit
  never runs dry: each Pumpjack on it still gets a trickle (40 mB a second).
  - **Crude Oil**, a thick black fluid, with its bucket.
  - **Seismic Survey Tool** (a comparator on a steel rod and plates). Use it on the ground to learn whether there's oil
    under the chunk: its kind, roughly how many buckets are left and how deep it lies, or that it's drained.
  - **Oil Derrick**, a 3×3 drilling rig six blocks tall over a deposit: a floor ring of Derrick Casings round an open
    bore with the Oil Derrick Controller in it, Derrick Frame legs on the corners and a 3×3 of frames on top. With FE
    (120 FE/t), water (10 mB/t of drilling mud) and Steel Pipes (one per 4 blocks of hole) it drills a block every 2
    seconds down to the deposit, then strikes oil: the rig comes down, handing back its blocks, and a Well Head caps
    the hole. A rig broken and rebuilt over the same hole carries on where it was. A drill string turns in the bore
    while it runs.
  - **Pumpjack**, a 3×5 skid of Pumpjack Casings round a Well Head, with a post three casings tall in the middle and a
    Pumpjack Controller at the far end. With FE (60 FE/t) it pumps Crude Oil out through Output ports or into
    buckets: 30 mB/t from a full deposit, slowing in a straight line to a quarter of that as it drains, then the
    trickle. It's modelled on a real beam pump: an A-frame post with a ladder and platform, a walking beam with a
    curved horse head over the well, and a gear reducer swinging two big crank counterweights. The beam nods slower as
    the pumping slows.
  - **Steel Pipe** (3 from two steel plates and a steel rod).
  - GUIs, Handbook pages (Crude Oil, Oil Derrick, Pumpjack), JEI categories (Oil Deposits; Oil Drilling), Jade
    tooltips (depth and pipes, pump rate and deposit left, the Well Head's deposit), the machine control API for both
    machines, GameTests, and the advancements Prospector, Black Gold, Nodding Donkey, Cut to Size and the challenge
    Fractionator. All values are in config (`world.oilDeposits`, `multiblocks.oilDerrick`, `multiblocks.pumpjack`).

mods.name: Arcforge
mods.description: Arcforge is a technology mod built on Forge Energy (FE), compatible with any NeoForge mod that uses the standard energy, fluid and item capabilities.

releases.notes:
### Added

- **`/arcforge debug conduits`** (admins): the conduit networks in your dimension, busiest first, each with its
  sources, targets (input sides), calls into machines' insert per tick and contents updates sent to players per second.

### Changed

- **Conduits use less server time.** They move the same amounts, shared out the same way:
  - Energy conduits move each tick's pull and push in one transaction. A machine that takes nothing (full) is left out
    for up to 8 ticks, asked first with a simulated insert when its wait ends, and fed straight away once it has room
    again. Networks with nothing stored skip the push entirely.
  - The FE and heat a network holds are only split back into its conduits when they're saved or the network changes,
    not every tick.
  - Item conduits work out once per network which inputs each output can reach, and an output with nothing to give is
    tried less often (at most 8 ticks apart, so only Hardened and Arcforged conduits notice).
  - Fluid, pressurized and item conduits send what they hold in a small packet instead of a full block update, at most
    once a tick per conduit, and a fluid level only once it has changed by 1/32 of a conduit.
- **Cube multiblocks** (the Arc Crushing, Induction Furnace, Metal Pressing, Superheater and Condenser Arrays and the
  Industrial Water Intake) check for a redstone signal only when a casing's neighbour changes, not across every casing
  every tick, and skip it altogether on Ignore. An idle Condenser Array with no water doesn't look for somewhere to push
  it.

### Fixed

- **The Steam Turbine, Steam Boiler and Gas Turbine Arrays' models no longer vanish at some angles.** They were only
  drawn while the chunk section holding the structure's corner block was visible; now they're drawn whenever any part
  of the structure is in view, and their draw distance counts from the nearest part of the structure.
- **The Steam Turbine Array's hitbox matches its model.** It's now taken from the model itself, pixel for pixel,
  instead of being built separately in rough steps, so what you see is what you click and walk on.
- **Every part of a big Steam Turbine Array can be clicked.** Parts deep inside a turbine 5 or more blocks across
  (the middle of a big casing, the pedestals between casings) open its GUI too, where clicks used to go through them.
- **Steam Turbine Array windows show the blades from any angle.** The stage rings between the blade rows are now a
  shallow lip at the casing wall, so they no longer hide the rotor when you look in at a slant.


---

mods.description: Arcforge is a technology mod built on Forge Energy (FE), compatible with any NeoForge mod that uses the standard energy, fluid and item capabilities.

releases.notes:
### Added

- **API 1.2.0:** `SideModes.MACHINE_LINK` (`"machine_link"`), the mode the machine control API reads on a face a Link
  Conduit is plugged into (see Upgrading). The API jar is `arcforge-api-1.2.0+26.3.jar`.
- **Iolite.** A new ore, found only in the End, in End Stone: a little on the main island and more on the outer
  islands, Y 0 to 80. It needs an iron pickaxe and drops Iolite Crystals (Fortune works; Silk Touch drops the ore). There
  is a Block of Iolite (9 crystals) and Iolite Dust (the Arc Crusher gives 2 per ore, the Arc Crushing Array 4, and a
  crystal crushes to 1); dust and ore smelt back into a crystal. Tags `c:gems/iolite`, `c:ores/iolite`, `c:dusts/iolite`,
  `c:storage_blocks/iolite` and `c:ores_in_ground/end_stone`. Advancement "Edge of the World".
- **Link Conduit.** A thin cable with an Iolite core (Iolite Crystal, copper and Plastic Sheet, 8 at a time) that links
  one machine or multiblock to one Wired Machine Link, through up to 64 blocks of cable. It carries nothing itself,
  never branches and joins no other conduits; its core glows purple while the link is live.
  - The face it plugs into (any face of a single machine, any outer face of a formed multiblock) becomes a **Wired
    Machine Link port**: purple, locked, and shown as "Wired Machine Link" in the machine's Sides or Ports tab and in
    Jade. The GUI, the Wrench, Settings Cards and the machine control API leave it alone while the cable is there, and
    taking the cable off gives the face back the mode it had.
  - A machine takes one Wired Machine Link.
- **Wired Machine Link.** A casing with Iolite accents and a status screen (Hardened Alloy, Iolite Crystals, steel
  plates and a Link Conduit) that works as a remote set of the linked machine's ports.
  - Each face other than the cable's can be set to any port mode the machine has, and works exactly as that port would
    on the machine: items, fluids, gases, FE and heat go straight to and from the machine's own inventories, tanks and
    buffers, with no limit of its own. Conduits connect to it as they would to the machine. Output faces push with the
    machine's auto-eject, and Energy and Heat faces give out what the machine gives out.
  - Its GUI shows the machine it's linked to (for example "Steam Boiler Array 7×7×16"), the face the cable is on, the
    cable's length, and a face grid like the Sides tab. A broken or overlong cable, a cable to nothing, a machine that
    already has a link, or one whose owner hasn't let you use it shows "Not linked" and why.
  - Jade shows the linked machine and each face's mode, and on the machine, its link port. Handbook entry, JEI
    information, and the advancement "Long Arm" (new trigger `arcforge:machine_linked`).
- **Industrial Water Intake.** A 3×3×3 multiblock pump house that stands in a body of at least 400 connected water
  sources and pumps 8,000 mB/t of water (×1.25 in rivers and oceans) for 0.25 FE per mB, enough for a full-size Steam
  Boiler Array. Its Output ports push as fast as it pumps, so they can feed a boiler's water port directly. It has its
  own GUI, Jade tooltip, Handbook page and JEI build view. The water isn't taken from the world. Settings in
  `power.steam.waterIntake`.
- **Heat Pipe.** A late-game block for moving a lot of heat between multiblocks. Heat Pipes in a straight line form one
  pipe of up to 32 blocks that joins only the heat ports or heat faces at its two ends, and carries up to 262,144 HU/t
  from the hotter end to the colder one, losing 0.5% per block of length. It's one unbroken steel jacket with flanged
  caps at its ends, and a window band whose core glows with the heat it carries. Jade shows its length, loss, rate and
  temperature. Settings in `power.heat.heatPipe`.
- **"Limited by connections" warning.** The Firebox Array, Fuel Burner, Firebox, Geothermal Plant, Solar Thermal Array,
